meta.title: Wrong totals sent by a vendor cannot make it L1
gaps: The available operations cannot submit intentionally incorrect line totals while retaining real prices and quantities, so recomputation of totals and confirmation that ₹1 appears nowhere are not checked.
The read_indicators read-back vocabulary exposes best_bidder but not the numeric L1 rank or best total.
the case reads as “it is refused”, but the plan checks “it is accepted”
warnings: verify 1: read_indicators's reply shape has not been sampled; "auction_identifiers_data.{{vendor2Uuid}}.inline.{{lineItemUuid}}.rank.best_bidder" is unverified

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live pricing round with 1 audience to add uuids.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 100 (open, price, submit).
A second QA vendor places a complete bid of 50 (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that Data check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals true.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals true.
